_comment: The target devices of the browser installer, and the only place that lists them. Read by tools/pack_web_install.sh to know what to build and stage, and by website/install/index.html to fill the device picker. One list, two readers - adding a device is an edit here and nowhere else. A device here is the BOARD, not a product: two products on one board would share an entry and differ only in their build environment. The emulator (PANEL_SIM) is deliberately absent - it is a build machine's tool, not something anyone installs.
